Int_0^1 sin(1/x)/x dx: closed form pi/2 - Si(1) (mpmath; PARI eint1) == mpmath quadosc of Int_1^oo sin t/t dt, dps 80: 80 digits agree

Int_0^1 cos(log(x)/x) dx: no closed form: mpmath quadosc of Int_0^oo cos(t e^t) e^-t dt (x = e^-t) with zeros W((n-1/2)pi), dps 80 == same with zero set W(n pi) (80 digits) == PARI/gp sumalt over intnum pieces between W((n-1/2)pi), \p 90 (siam100_refs/bc1_ref.gp): 70+ digits agree

Int_0^oo cos(x)/sqrt(x) dx: closed form sqrt(pi/2) == mpmath quadosc of Int_0^oo 2 cos(u^2) du (x = u^2), dps 80: 80 digits agree

Int_0^1 sin(1/x)/sqrt(x) dx: closed form 2 sin 1 + 2 sqrt(pi/2)(1 - 2 C(sqrt(2/pi))) (Fresnel C, mpmath) == PARI Im(Gamma(-1/2,-i) (-i)^(1/2)) (incgam) == mpmath quadosc of Int_1^oo sin t t^(-3/2) dt: 80 digits agree

Int_0^oo J1(x)/sqrt(x) dx: closed form (Weber) Gamma(3/4)/(sqrt 2 Gamma(5/4)) == mpmath quad on [0,1] (x = u^2) + quadosc on [1,oo), dps 80: 80 digits agree
Int_0^oo cos(x^3) dx: closed form Gamma(4/3) cos(pi/6) == mpmath quadosc(cos(x^3), zeros cbrt((n-1/2)pi)), dps 80: 80 digits agree

Int_2^oo sin(x)/log(x) dx: no closed form: mpmath quadosc(sin x/log x, [2,oo], omega 1), dps 80 == same with zeros n pi (80 digits) == PARI/gp sumalt over intnum pieces [k pi,(k+1) pi], \p 90 (siam100_refs/bc1_ref.gp): 70+ digits agree
